s0201.literal: Theri Lu Pya Aditya was enfeoffed as king of Burma, and an edict addressed him, saying: "Since our state was first established by our ancestors, the myriad realms and all people have none who failed to revere our might and embrace our virtue.
s0201.idiomatic: Theri Lu Pya Aditya was enfeoffed as king of Burma, and an edict addressed him, saying, "Since our state was first established by our ancestors, the myriad realms and all people have none who failed to revere our might and embrace our virtue.

s0202.literal: During the days when the former court held sway, your state's envoys reported and entered audience on command; an edict approved their request.
s0202.idiomatic: During the days when the former court held sway, your state's envoys reported and entered audience on command; an edict approved their request.

s0203.literal: Yet you then suddenly broke your earlier promises, wherefore our border-generals and regional commanders sent troops against you.
s0203.idiomatic: Yet you then suddenly broke your earlier promises, wherefore our border-generals and regional commanders sent troops against you.

s0204.literal: Recently you sent your son Senkapati to present a memorial and come to court; it is fitting to show forbearance and specially increase favors; We now enfeoff Theri Lu Pya Aditya as king of Burma and grant him a silver seal;
s0204.idiomatic: Recently you sent your son Senkapati to present a memorial and come to court; it is fitting to show forbearance and specially increase favors; We now enfeoff Theri Lu Pya Aditya as king of Burma and grant him a silver seal;

s0205.literal: Senkapati is made heir apparent of Burma and granted a tiger tally.
s0205.idiomatic: Senkapati is made heir apparent of Burma and granted a tiger tally.

s0206.literal: We also admonish the frontier generals at Yunnan and elsewhere not to raise arms without authorization.
s0206.idiomatic: We also admonish the frontier generals at Yunnan and elsewhere not to raise arms without authorization.

s0207.literal: The officials and people of your state should each settle in their proper occupations.
s0207.idiomatic: The officials and people of your state should each settle in their proper occupations.

s0208.literal: " Also granted to the Burmese king's brother Sapangba a one-pearl tiger tally, to the chieftain Asan a three-pearl tiger tally, and to his followers gold tallies and gold currency, and they were dismissed.
s0208.idiomatic: Also granted to the Burmese king's brother Sapangba a one-pearl tiger tally, to the chieftain Asan a three-pearl tiger tally, and to his followers gold tallies and gold currency, and they were dismissed.

s0209.literal: Three thousand newly submitted troops were put to garrison farming at Zhangzhou.
s0209.idiomatic: 3,000 newly submitted troops were put to garrison farming at Zhangzhou.

s0210.literal: On gengshen day Ningdu and Huichang counties were promoted to prefectures, both subordinate to Ganzhou Route;
s0210.idiomatic: On gengshen day Ningdu and Huichang counties were promoted to prefectures, both subordinate to Ganzhou Route;

s0211.literal: Ningyang market-town was made a county subordinate to Jining Route;
s0211.idiomatic: Ningyang market-town was made a county subordinate to Jining Route;

s0212.literal: the Yuzhou inspection post was made Hequ County, subordinate to Baode Prefecture.
s0212.idiomatic: the Yuzhou inspection post was made Hequ County, subordinate to Baode Prefecture.

s0213.literal: An Anfeng Route registrar's office was established.
s0213.idiomatic: An Anfeng Route registrar's office was established.

s0214.literal: Wang Qingduan, vice commissioner of the mobile bureau of palace affairs, was made right vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat.
s0214.idiomatic: Wang Qingduan, vice commissioner of the mobile bureau of palace affairs, was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0215.literal: An edict changed the reign title and granted amnesty throughout the realm.
s0215.idiomatic: An edict changed the reign title and granted amnesty throughout the realm.

s0216.literal: Corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were remitted for three years, and grain for three months was granted to the six thousand households under Gezhiye.
s0216.idiomatic: Corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing were remitted for three years, and grain for three months was granted to the 6,000 households under Gezhiye.

s0217.literal: Third month, wuchen day: Mars transgressed Well.
s0217.idiomatic: Third month, wuchen day: Mars transgressed Well.

s0218.literal: On jisi day Wanze and others memorialized fixing the regulations for selection and transfer.
s0218.idiomatic: On jisi day Wanze and others memorialized fixing the regulations for selection and transfer.

s0219.literal: On gengwu day Yeshi Temür, branch secretariat grand councillor of Shaanxi, was made central secretariat grand councillor, and Liang Andula, left vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0219.idiomatic: On gengwu day Yeshi Temür, branch secretariat grand councillor of Shaanxi, was made central secretariat grand councillor, and Liang Andula, left vice chancellor of the central secretariat, was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0220.literal: On guiyou day the Moon eclipsed the great star of Xuan Yuan.
s0220.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Moon eclipsed the great star of Xuan Yuan.

s0221.literal: A hunt was held at Willow Grove.
s0221.idiomatic: A hunt was held at Willow Grove.

s0222.literal: Corvée levies on newly submitted troops at Wudang Mountain were remitted.
s0222.idiomatic: Corvée levies on newly submitted troops at Wudang Mountain were remitted.

s0223.literal: On jiaxu day Western Tibetans raided Jie Prefecture; Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuoliebo advanced with troops to suppress them, all their bands were pacified, and five hundred troops were left to garrison.
s0223.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Western Tibetans raided Jie Prefecture; Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Tuoliebo advanced with troops to suppress them, all their bands were pacified, and 500 troops were left to garrison.

s0224.literal: An edict ordered each province to consolidate garrison troops: those stationed in Fujian were consolidated into fifty-three posts, and those in Jiang-Zhe into two hundred twenty-seven posts.
s0224.idiomatic: An edict ordered each province to consolidate garrison troops: those stationed in Fujian were consolidated into 53 posts, and those in Jiang-Zhe into 227 posts.

s0225.literal: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0225.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0226.literal: On dingchou day Prince Tiemur Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince Pacifier of the West, Martial and Tranquil, and granted a camel-button seal.
s0226.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Tiemur Buqa was enfeoffed as Prince Pacifier of the West, Martial and Tranquil, and granted a camel-button seal.

s0227.literal: Badmashin, left vice chancellor of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0227.idiomatic: Badmashin, left vice chancellor of the Jiangxi branch secretariat, was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0228.literal: On gengchen day Jalughuchi Tersu accepted bribes; when his slave reported him, he poisoned the slave to death and was sentenced to execution in the marketplace.
s0228.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jalughuchi Tersu accepted bribes; when his slave reported him, he poisoned the slave to death and was sentenced to execution in the marketplace.

s0229.literal: On yiyou day Ali was dispatched with eighty thousand ingots of paper currency to purchase grain at Karakorum.
s0229.idiomatic: On yiyou day Ali was dispatched with 80,000 ingots of paper currency to purchase grain at Karakorum.

s0230.literal: On dinghai day hunting was forbidden from the first through seventh months, likewise within eight hundred li of Dadu.
s0230.idiomatic: On dinghai day hunting was forbidden from the first through seventh months, likewise within 800 li of Dadu.

s0231.literal: On gengyin day the Jiang-Huai and other regions revenue supervisorate and intendant commissions were established.
s0231.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Jiang-Huai and other regions revenue supervisorate and intendant commissions were established.

s0232.literal: Princes Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa were each granted one hundred taels of gold; Ulus Buqa's mother Abucha and others five hundred taels of gold; silver and paper currency in varying amounts.
s0232.idiomatic: Princes Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa were each granted 100 taels of gold; Ulus Buqa's mother Abucha and others 500 taels of gold; silver and paper currency in varying amounts.

s0233.literal: Granted to Changhai artisan households twenty-two thousand nine hundred-odd ingots of paper currency to purchase farm implements, ten thousand ingots to impoverished households under Yaqutu, and ten thousand nine hundred-odd ingots to beji saddle artisans.
s0233.idiomatic: Granted to Changhai artisan households 22,900-odd ingots of paper currency to purchase farm implements, 10,000 ingots to impoverished households under Yaqutu, and 10,900-odd ingots to beji saddle artisans.

s0234.literal: When the Wutai Mountain Buddhist temple was completed, the empress dowager was about to go in person to pray and offer blessings; surveillance commissioner Li Yuanli submitted a sealed memorial to stop it.
s0234.idiomatic: When the Wutai Mountain Buddhist temple was completed, the empress dowager was about to go in person to pray and offer blessings; surveillance commissioner Li Yuanli submitted a sealed memorial to stop it.

s0235.literal: Guide, Xu, Pi, and Bianliang counties suffered flooding; their field rents were remitted.
s0235.idiomatic: Guide, Xu, Pi, and Bianliang counties suffered flooding; their field rents were remitted.

s0236.literal: Daozhou suffered drought and Liaoyang famine; grain was issued to relieve both.
s0236.idiomatic: Daozhou suffered drought and Liaoyang famine; grain was issued to relieve both.

s0237.literal: The people under Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa suffered famine; dairy cows and stallions were provided to aid them.
s0237.idiomatic: The people under Yuemuhuer and Ulus Buqa suffered famine; dairy cows and stallions were provided to aid them.

s0238.literal: Summer, fourth month, guisi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
s0238.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, guisi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

s0239.literal: On bingshen day Central Secretariat and Censorate officials said: "Alawadin and Cui Yu have itemized matters concerning the censorate and surveillance agencies; we deliberated and request that the old precedents be followed.
s0239.idiomatic: On bingshen day central secretariat and censorate officials said, "Alawadin and Cui Yu have itemized matters concerning the censorate and surveillance agencies; we deliberated and request that the old precedents be followed.

s0240.literal: The Censorate shall not establish a separate selection list; its personnel shall be chosen from regularly transferred officials, save that surveillance commissioners as chief officers shall be selected by the Censorate itself.
s0240.idiomatic: The censorate shall not establish a separate selection list; its personnel shall be chosen from regularly transferred officials, save that surveillance commissioners as chief officers shall be selected by the censorate itself.

s0241.literal: Each circuit surveillance commission must select a Mongol as commissioner; if none is available, then a semuren hereditary-official descendant; below that, semuren and Han may be mixed in.
s0241.idiomatic: Each circuit surveillance commission must select a Mongol as commissioner; if none is available, then a semuren hereditary-official descendant; below that, semuren and Han may be mixed in.

s0242.literal: Further, for Kheshig and Asud each to nominate surveillance commissioners is inconvenient; they too should be limited to selection from regular transfers.
s0242.idiomatic: Further, for Kheshig and Asud each to nominate surveillance commissioners is inconvenient; they too should be limited to selection from regular transfers.

s0243.literal: Documents of each province shall be audited by officials dispatched from the branch censorate.
s0243.idiomatic: Documents of each province shall be audited by officials dispatched from the branch censorate.

s0244.literal: For palace guards and personal attendants whom special edict directs the censorate and surveillance agencies to promote, explicit memorial must first be submitted before appointment.
s0244.idiomatic: For palace guards and personal attendants whom special edict directs the censorate and surveillance agencies to promote, explicit memorial must first be submitted before appointment.

s0245.literal: Branch censorate commissioners who complete their terms with effective performance may be transferred to the inner censorate or recommended to the Central Secretariat for reassignment; surveillance commissions likewise;
s0245.idiomatic: Branch censorate commissioners who complete their terms with effective performance may be transferred to the inner censorate or recommended to the central secretariat for reassignment; surveillance commissions likewise;

s0246.literal: those unfit for office shall be replaced by persons chosen by the secretariat or censorate.
s0246.idiomatic: those unfit for office shall be replaced by persons chosen by the secretariat or censorate.

s0247.literal: those who have not served in executive offices shall be given posts governing the people;
s0247.idiomatic: those who have not served in executive offices shall be given posts governing the people;

s0248.literal: those jointly selected by secretariat and censorate may be assigned at the Censorate's discretion.
s0248.idiomatic: those jointly selected by secretariat and censorate may be assigned at the censorate's discretion.

s0249.literal: When the Central Secretariat wishes to use censorial personnel, it should likewise deliberate with the Censorate; officials of each agency and surveillance commission must not enter and inspect on their own authority.
s0249.idiomatic: When the central secretariat wishes to use censorial personnel, it should likewise deliberate with the censorate; officials of each agency and surveillance commission must not enter and inspect on their own authority.

s0250.literal: We now propose that except for transport-salt commissions, all other agencies follow entirely the old precedents.
s0250.idiomatic: We now propose that except for transport-salt commissions, all other agencies follow entirely the old precedents.

s0252.literal: On renyin day Ulus Buqa was granted a round tally.
s0252.idiomatic: On renyin day Ulus Buqa was granted a round tally.

s0253.literal: Those from Siam and Lavo who came to court were granted clothing in varying amounts.
s0253.idiomatic: Those from Siam and Lavo who came to court were granted clothing in varying amounts.

s0254.literal: Ten thousand ingots were granted to Yaqutu's household; seed for garrison farming at Karakorum was given to Yuemuhuer's household; two thousand shi of grain relieved Yingchang Prefecture.
s0254.idiomatic: 10,000 ingots were granted to Yaqutu's household; seed for garrison farming at Karakorum was given to Yuemuhuer's household; 2,000 shi of grain relieved Yingchang Prefecture.

s0255.literal: Fifth month, bingyin day: the Yellow River breached its banks at Bianliang; more than thirty thousand civilians were mobilized to block it.
s0255.idiomatic: Fifth month, bingyin day: the Yellow River breached its banks at Bianliang; more than 30,000 civilians were mobilized to block it.

s0256.literal: On wuchen day Annam sent envoys to court.
s0256.idiomatic: On wuchen day Annam sent envoys to court.

s0257.literal: Commissioners' patents and relay tickets issued to princes conducting commerce were recalled.
s0257.idiomatic: Commissioners' patents and relay tickets issued to princes conducting commerce were recalled.

s0258.literal: An order directed Muslim merchants in inner commanderies to pay commercial taxes.
s0258.idiomatic: An order directed Muslim merchants in inner commanderies to pay commercial taxes.

s0259.literal: One thousand ingots were granted to build a Buddhist temple at Lintao.
s0259.idiomatic: 1,000 ingots were granted to build a Buddhist temple at Lintao.

s0260.literal: An edict: for robbers who raped and injured victims, leaders and followers all executed;
s0260.idiomatic: An edict: for robbers who raped and injured victims, leaders and followers all executed;

s0261.literal: where victims were not injured, only the leader executed, followers tattooed and exiled, and repeat offenders likewise executed.
s0261.idiomatic: where victims were not injured, only the leader executed, followers tattooed and exiled, and repeat offenders likewise executed.

s0262.literal: One relay ticket was granted to the Gemman pacification commission.
s0262.idiomatic: One relay ticket was granted to the Gemman pacification commission.

s0263.literal: On xinwei day the wife of military-household man Ren Fu of Suining Prefecture bore three sons in one delivery; corvée was remitted for three years.
s0263.idiomatic: On xinwei day the wife of military-household man Ren Fu of Suining Prefecture bore three sons in one delivery; corvée was remitted for three years.

s0264.literal: On guiyou day Venus transgressed Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.
s0264.idiomatic: On guiyou day Venus transgressed Ghost Accumulated Corpse Qi.

s0265.literal: On yihai day the Moon transgressed Fang.
s0265.idiomatic: On yihai day the Moon transgressed Fang.

s0266.literal: On dingchou day the people were forbidden to catch and sell hawks and falcons.
s0266.idiomatic: On dingchou day the people were forbidden to catch and sell hawks and falcons.

s0267.literal: On gengyin day a Pingfa chieftain submitted and requested subordination to Yiqibuxie; this was approved.
s0267.idiomatic: On gengyin day a Pingfa chieftain submitted and requested subordination to Yiqibuxie; this was approved.

s0268.literal: For route-level leveling circulation offices, the old system selected wealthy and capable local residents as deputies; an order directed that henceforth regularly transferred officials be appointed; those subordinate to branch secretariats were to be assigned by the branch secretariat.
s0268.idiomatic: For route-level leveling circulation offices, the old system selected wealthy and capable local residents as deputies; an order directed that henceforth regularly transferred officials be appointed; those subordinate to branch secretariats were to be assigned by the branch secretariat.

s0269.literal: Huang Shengxu, rebel bandit of Shangsi Prefecture, sent his son Zhibao to submit.
s0269.idiomatic: Huang Shengxu, rebel bandit of Shangsi Prefecture, sent his son Zhibao to submit.

s0270.literal: The Zhang River overflowed and damaged the people's grain crops.
s0270.idiomatic: The Zhang River overflowed and damaged the people's grain crops.

s0271.literal: Poyang and Leping in Raozhou and Longxing Route suffered flooding.
s0271.idiomatic: Poyang and Leping in Raozhou and Longxing Route suffered flooding.

s0272.literal: Yiqilie and two other stations suffered famine; one hundred fifty shi of grain was issued as relief.
s0272.idiomatic: Yiqilie and two other stations suffered famine; 150 shi of grain was issued as relief.

s0273.literal: Sixth month, jiawu day: Prince Yeligan sent envoys using relay posts to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers; an order recalled their relay tickets and sternly rebuked him.
s0273.idiomatic: Sixth month, jiawu day: Prince Yeligan sent envoys using relay posts to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks and Four Rivers; an order recalled their relay tickets and sternly rebuked him.

s0274.literal: Because Huguang branch secretariat associate administrator Cui Zhiliang was honest but impoverished, one thousand ingots of salt-levy paper currency were specially granted.
s0274.idiomatic: Because Huguang branch secretariat associate administrator Cui Zhiliang was honest but impoverished, 1,000 ingots of salt-levy paper currency were specially granted.

s0275.literal: One hundred thousand ingots were granted for Karakorum military supplies.
s0275.idiomatic: 100,000 ingots were granted for Karakorum military supplies.

s0276.literal: On yiwei day Venus was visible in daytime.
s0276.idiomatic: On yiwei day Venus was visible in daytime.

s0277.literal: On wuxu day nine stockades of Pingfa submitted; a native-official office was established.
s0277.idiomatic: On wuxu day nine stockades of Pingfa submitted; a native-official office was established.

s0278.literal: On jiyou day each palace-guard unit was ordered to deliver fifteen thousand shi of grain each to Shangdu and Longxing in the northern territories.
s0278.idiomatic: On jiyou day each palace-guard unit was ordered to deliver 15,000 shi of grain each to Shangdu and Longxing in the northern territories.

s0279.literal: On jiayin day the annual tribute of horses and felt garments from Yixibuxue was abolished.
s0279.idiomatic: On jiayin day the annual tribute of horses and felt garments from Yixibuxue was abolished.

s0280.literal: On bingchen day surveillance commissioner Woluoshila said: "Vice censor-in-chief Cui Yu's elder brother once committed an offense under the former court; restoring his confiscated household property is improper.
s0280.idiomatic: On bingchen day surveillance commissioner Woluoshila said, "Vice censor-in-chief Cui Yu's elder brother once committed an offense under the former court; restoring his confiscated household property is improper.

s0281.literal: He also purchased a monastic water mill in violation of regulations.
s0281.idiomatic: He also purchased a monastic water mill in violation of regulations.

s0282.literal: " The Emperor considered his statement reckless and had him beaten with the bastinado.
s0282.idiomatic: The Emperor considered his statement reckless and had him beaten with the bastinado.

s0283.literal: An edict: monks and Daoists who commit rape, theft, or other serious crimes may be interrogated by the regular authorities.
s0283.idiomatic: An edict: monks and Daoists who commit rape, theft, or other serious crimes may be interrogated by the regular authorities.

s0284.literal: Twenty thousand ingots were granted to the followers of Prince Yeligan and others; five thousand-odd ingots to impoverished people at thirteen stations of Duosima.
s0284.idiomatic: 20,000 ingots were granted to the followers of Prince Yeligan and others; 5,000-odd ingots to impoverished people at 13 stations of Duosima.

s0285.literal: That month: Pinghuan Route suffered silkworms eating mulberry leaves; Guide, Xu, and Pi Prefectures locusts; Taiyuan wind and hail; Hejian and Daming Route drought; Liyang County in He Prefecture Yangtze flooding, drowning more than eighteen thousand five hundred dwellings.
s0285.idiomatic: That month: Pinghuan Route suffered silkworms eating mulberry leaves; Guide, Xu, and Pi Prefectures locusts; Taiyuan wind and hail; Hejian and Daming Route drought; Liyang County in He Prefecture Yangtze flooding, drowning more than 18,500 dwellings.

s0286.literal: More than four thousand shi of grain relieved famine victims in Guangping Route; fifteen thousand shi relieved flood-stricken households in Jiangxi; more than two hundred ninety shi relieved famine households at four stations including Tieligan.
s0286.idiomatic: More than 4,000 shi of grain relieved famine victims in Guangping Route; 15,000 shi relieved flood-stricken households in Jiangxi; more than 290 shi relieved famine households at four stations including Tieligan.

s0287.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu day: the Moon transgressed Fang.
s0287.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, gengwu day: the Moon transgressed Fang.

s0288.literal: On xinwei day Toto, Boluochi, and Shatuo'er were each granted two thousand ingots, their households more than eighty-four thousand ingots; Sadushili one thousand ingots, his households more than twenty thousand ingots.
s0288.idiomatic: On xinwei day Toto, Boluochi, and Shatuo'er were each granted 2,000 ingots, their households more than 84,000 ingots; Sadushili 1,000 ingots, his households more than 20,000 ingots.

s0289.literal: The Mongol Army wanhu office was abolished and merged into the Quxiantalin Chief Commander's Office.
s0289.idiomatic: The Mongol Army wanhu office was abolished and merged into the Quxiantalin Chief Commander's Office.

s0290.literal: On guiwei day garrison-farming households under the Prince of Jin were increased.
s0290.idiomatic: On guiwei day garrison-farming households under the Prince of Jin were increased.

s0291.literal: On jiashen day one post was added to the Central Imperial Guard Office.
s0291.idiomatic: On jiashen day one post was added to the Central Imperial Guard Office.

s0292.literal: A two-pearl tiger tally was granted to Tazi of Ma'bar.
s0292.idiomatic: A two-pearl tiger tally was granted to Tazi of Ma'bar.

s0293.literal: An edict: those dispatched on missions to summon and instruct were granted the titles envoy to summon and instruct and deputy;
s0293.idiomatic: An edict: those dispatched on missions to summon and instruct were granted the titles envoy to summon and instruct and deputy;

s0294.literal: those fetching medicinals were granted Huitong Hostel commissioner and deputy; only edict-dispatch was issued, without formal commission.
s0294.idiomatic: those fetching medicinals were granted Huitong Hostel commissioner and deputy; only edict-dispatch was issued, without formal commission.

s0295.literal: On bingxu day grain at Ba'ersi Tucang was placed under the Shangdu defense commissioner; Song troops garrisoning the Two Jiang were registered and recruited.
s0295.idiomatic: On bingxu day grain at Ba'ersi Tucang was placed under the Shangdu defense commissioner; Song troops garrisoning the Two Jiang were registered and recruited.

s0296.literal: On dinghai day wine levies at Shangdu were remitted for three years.
s0296.idiomatic: On dinghai day wine levies at Shangdu were remitted for three years.

s0297.literal: Prince Buyan Temür and his younger brother Bozhen Boluo were granted four thousand ingots, their households more than eighty-four thousand eight hundred ingots, and grain for one year.
s0297.idiomatic: Prince Buyan Temür and his younger brother Bozhen Boluo were granted 4,000 ingots, their households more than 84,800 ingots, and grain for one year.

s0298.literal: Ninghai Prefecture suffered famine; more than nine thousand four hundred shi of grain was issued as relief.
s0298.idiomatic: Ninghai Prefecture suffered famine; more than 9,400 shi of grain was issued as relief.

s0299.literal: The Yellow River breached its banks at Pu mouth in Qi County.
s0299.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached its banks at Pu mouth in Qi County.

s0300.literal: Chenzhou Route, Leiyang Prefecture, and Ling County in Heng Prefecture suffered great flood and mountain collapse; more than three hundred persons drowned.
s0300.idiomatic: Chenzhou Route, Leiyang Prefecture, and Ling County in Heng Prefecture suffered great flood and mountain collapse; more than 300 persons drowned.
